1.description: I want to understand more about my fever. The fever has been accompanied by nausea, muscle ache and fatigue. I vomitted three times yesterday even after taking some panadol.
1.persona: You are a 30 year old working adult with a history of diabetes. Your job requires you to be in office and you can't work from home. You also have an infant daughter that will be at home all day. She was premature and born 2 weeks early.
